title: Australia news live: community at Gellibrand warned too late to leave as Otways bushfire grows; manhunt continues in remote NSW
summary: Smoke hangs over Victoria as out-of-control fire at Carlisle river in state’s southwest continues. Follow updates live Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast ‘Challenging’ conditions for firefighters in Victoria’s west As residents in Gellibrand in Victoria’s west have been told it is too late to leave with a bushfire at Carlisle River just one kilometre from the town, Forest fire management Victoria chief fire officer Chris Hardman said yesterday’s extremely hot day in the state made it challenging for firefighters. That fire is right on the edge of Gellibrand and that fire will continue to move today. And the conditions are a little bit milder, so firefighters will do everything they can to protect the community assets in and around Gellibrand. That’s not necessarily going to threaten communities in the days ahead but that fire could significantly increase in size and continue to challenge firefighters for many weeks to come. These fires can continue to grow and challenge us. This is very early in the season, this is the peak of the fire season now. We have had some terrible fires but it’s not a time to turn our gaze away from the challenges ahead. Continue reading...

title: Starmer allies urge him to block Andy Burnham from running in byelection
summary: Greater Manchester mayor has applied to stand for Labour in Gorton and Denton, setting up potential fight for PM’s political future Keir Starmer’s allies are urging him to block Andy Burnham from running in the Gorton and Denton byelection, after the Greater Manchester mayor declared his intention to stand, setting up a potential fight for the prime minister’s political future. Burnham said on Saturday he wanted to contest the seat after the sitting MP, Andrew Gwynne, said he intended to stand down. Continue reading...

title: Man killed in Minneapolis by federal agents identified as VA nurse Alex Pretti: ‘He wanted to help people’
summary: Pretti, 37, worked in the ICU at the Minneapolis VA Health Care System and had assisted on scientific research Minneapolis shooting – latest updates 37-year-old US citizen shot and killed by federal agents in Minneapolis ‘You’re terrorizing us’: Protesters take to Minneapolis streets after federal agents kill second US citizen The Minnesota man who was killed by federal agents on Saturday has been identified as Alex Pretti, 37, a registered nurse working in the intensive care unit at the Minneapolis VA Health Care System, which serves veterans. It’s the second fatal shooting this month in Minneapolis, Minnesota, in addition to another non-fatal shooting, amid a major crackdown in Minnesota by federal agents. Continue reading...
